description: Edits one of your listings: name, punchline, description, category, pricing model or Twitter handle, under the dashboard's rules. Editing a listing that is not live sends it back for review; a live listing stays live. A rejected listing cannot be edited.

description.description: What it does and for whom, factual, in plain text. The 1,000-character limit counts &, < and > as several characters each

pricing_model.description: How the maker charges for it

punchline.description: One line on what it does

twitter.description: The product's Twitter or X handle, like @neeed. Empty clears it

name: update_listing

status.description: live: public. in_review: waiting on a review. changes_requested: edit it to send it back. rejected: final. hidden_badge_missing: hidden until the badge is back and verified

title: Update a listing
